summary: Build skills taxonomy and ontology models for workforce planning, mobility, and talent analytics. Enrol in practical 5-day training.
lede: A skills ontology maps how skills relate to roles, learning paths, and one another, adding context beyond a simple hierarchy. For HR and workforce-planning practitioners, this course develops a maintainable skills structure to support talent decisions. You’ll practice classifying skills, mapping prerequisite and adjacent relationships, validating AI-assisted mappings, and setting governance and quality controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to design, validate, or operationalize skills structures that support talent decisions, learning architecture, and workforce planning.
prerequisites: Intermediate experience in HR, talent management, workforce planning, learning design, or HR data analysis is recommended. You should have working familiarity with job roles, competency models, or skills frameworks, and comfort using spreadsheets or structured templates. No programming is required, although experience with skills data platforms, HRIS outputs, or talent analytics tools will help you apply the exercises more quickly.
